info.about: Manhunt 2 is a 2007 stealth game by Rockstar Games. It was developed by Rockstar London for Microsoft Windows and PlayStation 2, Rockstar Leeds for the PlayStation Portable, and Rockstar Toronto for the Wii.
info.trivia: To get an M rating instead of Adults Only, Rockstar blurred the executions and removed the scoring system that rewarded brutal kills.
info.why: Its Adults Only rating and bans in Britain, Ireland and Germany made it notorious, and only the edited M-rated version was ever sold on PS2.
